articles.title: 'She never tried to mould us’: Kajol reveals the biggest gift Tanuja gave her
articles.description: Kajol shared insights about her mother's liberal parenting style during an appearance on a chat show. articles.title: 'Friend unresponsive, please send ambulance': Pune techie's chilling 112 call after beating girlfriend to death in PG room
articles.description: A 30-year-old software engineer allegedly killed his 27-year-old girlfriend after an argument at her accommodation. The couple, who had been in a relationship for three-and-a-half years, argued over various issues. Following dinner, the argument escalated into violence, resulting in her death. The accused called the police the next morning claiming she was unresponsive. Authorities discovered her unresponsive body and later established the suspect's involvement in her death.

articles.title: Gurgaon man buys Rs 1.73 lakh LG refrigerator, faces five compressor failures, consumer commission orders replacement and Rs 61,000 payout
articles.description: A consumer faced persistent failures with their LG refrigerator and sought resolution through a commission. After multiple breakdowns, the commission found the companies responsible for service deficiencies. The consumer provided evidence of the refrigerator's faults and previous communication attempts. Consequently, the commission ordered a replacement and compensation for mental distress and litigation expenses. The companies must comply within 45 days or face further legal consequences.
